music.title: Ariadne auf Naxos
music.description: Strauss and Hofmannsthal nest the abandoned princess inside a comedy of opera itself — Naxos as meta-theatre.

popCulture.title: Ariadne
popCulture.description: Theseus' left-behind guide becomes Dionysus' bride — Naxos as the island of abandonment and apotheosis.
